ordered_diagnoses: Cerebral Autosomal Dominant Arteriopathy with Subcortical Infarcts and Leukoencephalopathy

s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent episodes of transient neurological dysfunction with worsening frequency and duration
salient_findings: Worsening frequency and duration of episodes
Dysarthria and midline tongue extension on examination
key_facts: 20-day history of episodic slurred speech
Episodes initially lasted 10 minutes, later lasting 30 minutes
Episodes occurred 2-3 times daily at presentation
No loss of consciousness, headache, dizziness, diplopia, dysphagia, or limb weakness during episodes
Medical history of hypertension, diabetes mellitus, and coronary heart disease
Bilateral blindness after retinal detachment in adolescence
Denies smoking and alcohol use
Normal routine blood tests, coagulation studies, and imaging studies
Mild cerebral arteriosclerosis on MRA
Carotid arteriosclerosis with limited stenosis of the intracranial left vertebral artery on carotid MRA
